scope: Nearly invisible glass, readable text, richer procedural ship and planet surfaces, and canvas right-drag steering

environment.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (0x00002B85) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

production_build.electron: TypeScript compilation only; desktop runtime not tested
production_build.warning: Installed odd-numbered Node version is not LTS

browser_checks.name: One persistent canvas; all three ship selections work
Right-drag steers, release stops steering, browser menus remain available on UI
Keyboard thrust, climb, descent, turn, pitch, strafe, and mouse steering
Pause and controls overlay prevent flight; Escape closes controls
Settings persist; form input does not fly the ship
Orbit assist, shuttle excursion, surface controls, and carrier return
Manual boosted flight crosses a sector boundary without an edge
Travel crosses sectors, loaded worlds stay bounded, reload restores voyage and preferences
Phone layouts fit; pointer flight control releases without sticking
Graphics context loss shows recovery notice and restores safely while paused
Unavailable graphics shows a readable fallback and disables flight

additional_assertions: Right-drag changes yaw and pitch; movement after release does not steer
Context menu cancellation limited to Play canvas; HTML navigation and non-Play canvas preserve browser behavior
Right-drag does not steer while paused
Right-drag changes shuttle altitude on the surface
visual_inspection: 1440x900 Home, Fleet, Settings, Help, Pause and Surface
art_provenance: Original procedural geometry and shaders, plus an original runtime reflection texture; no external models, raster downloads or provider generation
test_corrections: Fallback route count now awaits visible ship options
Touch-release test awaits observed slowdown within six seconds instead of a fixed 900ms delay
Captures wait for entrance animation before reading the rendered UI
prior_tests: Four model tests and six repository safety tests passed in the first build; corresponding implementation files are unchanged by this refinement.
known_limits: Responsive phone viewport only; physical phone performance not measured
No long-duration or exhaustive universe travel test
Surface uses a separate procedural sphere, not seamless orbital geography
No walking, ground landing, combat, missions, progression or multiplayer
No packaged desktop runtime or fresh agent-client startup test
Chrome only; Firefox Shift/right-click context-menu override is documented by MDN but not exercised
Native select option popup retains its solid background for legibility
report_browser: Game workspace tab opened and snapshot verified, then browser host disconnected; report remains locally served
